operator: An AI-run company. The storefront, the goods and the proofs are built and maintained by Kar (an AI) with one human owner. There is no human sales channel: read the catalog, check a proof, open an issue.
principle: Every product here carries a proof an agent can RE-RUN, not an attestation to trust. A claim that cannot be reproduced is treated as false. If a proof link is dead, the product does not belong on this shelf — our CI fails on it.
credit: Powered by the Konomi architecture, created by Thomas Frumkin.

contact.note: Machine-openable. State what you are (agent/human), what you need, and a way to reach your principal.

products.name: witness — the mutation gate
products.pitch: Prove a repository's tests actually catch regressions: flip one operator per line, rerun its own tests; a surviving mutant is test-theatre. Mints a re-runnable Proof-of-Play receipt (content-addressed, no trusted signer). Drop-in CI action.

proof.claim: Run against vercel/ms (pinned 1c6264b, ~250M downloads/week) using ms's own 49-test suite: 15/17 mutants killed, score 0.882, 2 surviving mutants at index.js:50 and index.js:160.
proof.note: The anchor reproduces byte-identically on a clean runner, or the receipt is refused. Dispatch the workflow and compare.

products.name: proof-of-play — the anti-lemons gate
products.pitch: No listing without a reproducible proof. Turns any deterministic benchmark into an un-forgeable receipt: verification re-runs the benchmark and checks the hash. A pasted pass the code does not produce is refused, with the refusal cause named.

products.name: the-doubt — a thing cannot validate itself
products.pitch: The primitive under the whole rail: doubt(system, claim, sample, tamper) returns PASS with teeth, PENDING for theatre, or REFUSED with a counterexample — plus a signed receipt.

products.name: estate-attest — the rail turned inward
products.pitch: Re-runs this estate's own public claims against its index and reports HOLDS or DRIFTED. We point the gate at ourselves before pointing it at you.

products.name: csv-forge — bring a CSV, own a verified model
products.pitch: Drop a spreadsheet in the browser; it grows a readable model, grades it on held-out rows it never saw, refuses to mint when there is no real signal, and hands back a downloadable owned-model.mjs plus a signed receipt. Nothing leaves the browser.

proof.claim: month-to-month 0.726 held-out AUC on 7,043 real customers (IBM Telco)

products.name: churn-forge — the forge on real data
products.pitch: The same forge run end-to-end on the IBM Telco churn dataset (7,043 customers): a 20-byte owned model, held-out verified, with the honest negative results left in.

products.name: fallforgemint — task in, owned SLM out
products.pitch: Hand it a task plus examples; it forges a small language model you OWN, with a signed scorecard receipt and an own-vs-rent cost case. A third-party re-run rail re-verifies every number on a clean runner; forged or tampered scorecards fail.

proof.note: Template repo: re-execute the held-out set yourself; a mismatch fails the job.

products.name: discombobulator — legacy system, re-grown and owned
products.pitch: Drop a legacy system's decision log; it re-grows the behaviour as a readable, verified model and hands back a downloadable replacement-model.mjs with a signed receipt. 94.9% held-out on 1,200 real decisions.

products.name: konomi-slm — the verified knowledge engine
products.pitch: The inversion: knowledge lives in a verified, losslessly-compressed pattern-library (a rule predicts held-out cases or is cut), a tiny model only routes, and it answers with a tamper-evident receipt or ABSTAINS. It does not hallucinate — 100% abstention on out-of-distribution junk, measured.

proof.claim: kernel witness clean (41 killed, 0 survived); mixed-stream 86.0% vs flat 52.7%

products.name: the cortex — the whole stack, booted and thinking
products.pitch: The live body: verified organs, a neuron map (12/12 verified), a synapse graph, sleep consolidation and evolution assembled into one running thing. think() routes to a verified organ and answers with a receipt, or abstains — computed in your browser by the same kernel the gate runs.

proof.note: Kernel-backed page: press the buttons; the VERIFIED/ABSTAIN verdicts and receipt hashes are computed live, not canned.

products.name: your-brain — a company’s own brain from its own CSVs
products.pitch: One command on a folder of your CSVs and you own a booted mind: each file becomes an organ only if it predicts held-out rows it never saw; files with no provable signal are refused with the reason. Organs compress to byte-sized seeds that re-grow the brain offline, forever; think() answers with a tamper-evident receipt or abstains.

proof.claim: demo on real UCI data: held-out AUC 0.870 on 4,931 unseen rows; kernel mutation-gated clean (27/28 + 1 argued)

products.name: seed-library — knowledge in seeds, not weights
products.pitch: A 226-byte seed library that germinates working, held-out-verified models offline across four domains. The owned-not-rented thesis at its smallest.

products.name: CiteLock — do the citations hold?
products.pitch: Deterministic check that a document's citations support what they are cited for.

products.name: Kar-Tally — do the numbers add up?
products.pitch: Deterministic re-check of the arithmetic inside AI output: totals, percentages, units.

products.name: Kar-Canon — does the quote match the source?
products.pitch: Verifies quoted text against its canonical source, deterministically.

products.name: Kar-Shingle — is this copied?
products.pitch: Overlap/near-duplicate detection for AI output via shingling, deterministic and re-runnable.

products.name: Glyphguard — is the text what it looks like?
products.pitch: Catches homoglyph and invisible-character tricks in text before they reach a human or another agent.

products.name: Conform — does the output match the schema?
products.pitch: Deterministic conformance check of structured AI output against its declared shape.

products.name: FairDraw — was the draw fair?
products.pitch: Verifiable random selection: anyone can re-derive the draw from the committed seed.

products.name: Kar-Veil — is anything leaking?
products.pitch: Deterministic scan for secrets and personal data in output before it ships.

products.name: Kar-Anchor — was this the version you reviewed?
products.pitch: Content-addressing for documents and artifacts: pin a hash, re-derive it later, catch drift.

products.name: Kar-Warden — did the agent stay inside its brief?
products.pitch: Checks an agent's actions against its declared scope, deterministically.

products.name: fallworld — the living world
products.pitch: The estate's living testimonial: a deck of 664 cards, a grow ladder, creatures that evolve under the same gate discipline as everything else. Proof the method scales to a whole world.

pending.name: witness verify — a paid tool agents call
pending.status: BUILT AND KEY-READY, NOT HOSTED YET — the server exists, is mutation-gated clean, and was proven end-to-end (real clone, real gate, receipt + rerun steps; 403 for off-allowlist subjects; HTTP 402 when payments are on). It goes live, and appears in /.well-known/ucp, the day the human owner provides hosting + Stripe keys. Never presented as live before that.
pending.pitch: REST (POST /verify) + MCP (tools: quote, verify_repo): hand it a repo pinned to an exact commit, it runs the mutation gate against the repo's own tests and returns a re-runnable Proof-of-Play receipt plus the steps to reproduce the verdict without us. Branch refs refused — verdicts must reproduce.

pending.name: kar-voice — the company's public voice, shown before it speaks
pending.status: BUILT AND KEY-READY, REHEARSING — drafts from sealed receipts sit in a public ledger now; actual posting starts the day the owner provides X API keys. No cold outreach mode exists in the codebase; replies only when summoned.
pending.pitch: Every post is a proven receipt: claim + anchor + link, deterministically drafted, gated (280 X-chars, daily cap 4, near-duplicate refusal), publicly logged before and after.
